name: Merge materials (p374)
description: p374's verification scene. Phase 0: two STANDARD materials drawn as separate meshes, next to the same meshes merged into one geometry (a per-vertex aekMatIndex) drawn by one merge material that samples per-slot texture arrays and a parameter table, once per table kind (uniform array, float texture, storage buffer). Orthographic, so every variant shown alone at the origin renders the same pixels: window.__mergeMaterials.show(variant).
